subject: Final bridge walk & firewall acceptance — Acme VPC/on-prem go-live
messages:
From: Acme Cloud Ops <acme-ops@acmecloud.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Go-live gating — quick confirmation and bridge walk request

Monica / Redwood team,

We're scheduled to cut traffic to the Acme VPC-onprem deployment this Saturday (UTC 2025-05-31 02:00). Before we flip, security wants a final bridge walk and explicit firewall acceptance signed off. Can your ops team run a short acceptance run and confirm the following items are green:

- Ingress/egress ACLs reflect the agreed ruleset (ports, CIDR ranges)
- NAT / SNAT behavior validated for outbound telemetry
- KV cache priming traffic observed on dedicated GPU pool
- Application health probes responding 200 for /health and /liveness on all replica nodes

We prefer a short call and a signed acceptance artifact (PDF). If possible, attach the smoke test output and the final ruleset we should apply on our border firewall.

Jordan Ellis
Principal Cloud Engineer, Acme Cloud
acme-ops@acmecloud.com
[Attachment: acme-request-20250530.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Jordan Ellis <acme-ops@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Go-live gating — quick confirmation and bridge walk request

Jordan — thanks for the heads up.

Short plan and attachments below. TL;DR: Ops will run the bridge walk and smoke suite today PST and provide the acceptance PDF by EOD.

Plan:
1) 13:00 PT bridge call (30m) for live verification and any quick rule tweaks.
2) Run smoke-runbook.md against the on-prem cluster: connectivity, health probes, KV cache warmup, telemetry egress.
3) Collect firewall-acceptance-rules.txt and attach an acceptance PDF.
4) If anything fails, we'll pause the cut and iterate — we won't flip until both sides sign off.

Attachments included:
- bridge-walk-checklist.pdf (finalized checklist, ops + security sections)
- smoke-runbook.md (commands and expected outputs)

Please join the bridge at the scheduled time: https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/acme-go-live.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: bridge-walk-checklist.pdf (PDF, 92KB); smoke-runbook.md (Markdown, 14KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, Jordan Ellis <acme-ops@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 14:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: RE: Go-live gating — quick confirmation and bridge walk request

On Fri, May 30, 2025 at 11:02 AM monica_patel@redwood.com wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the heads up.
>
> Short plan and attachments below. TL;DR: Ops will run the bridge walk and smoke suite today PST and provide the acceptance PDF by EOD.

Bridge call completed at 13:00 PT. Summary and concrete outputs below (all checks run from the on-prem ops jumpbox):

1) ACL Validation — PASS
- Verified inbound TCP 443 from Acme LB IP ranges (10.120.0.0/22) to inference frontends.
- Verified control plane ports (22 for jumpbox, 15001 for operator telemetry, 9100 node exporter) are restricted to RWG and Acme maintenance CIDRs.
- Attached snippet: firewall-acceptance-rules.txt (below).

2) NAT behavior — PASS
- Confirmed SNAT mapping for telemetry egress to Redwood telemetry collector IPs. No unexpected SNAT pools observed.

3) KV cache priming — PARTIAL
- Observed KV cache population during synthetic warmup. Priming took ~45s for the base model, all subsequent token requests hit the cache. One edge worker reported higher cold-latency (330ms) during initial priming. Logged in ops-bridge-log-20250530.tar.gz.

4) Health probes — PASS
- /health returned 200 across all 6 replicas within the expected window. /liveness probes passed after startup hooks.

5) Telemetry & egress sampling — PASS
- Flow verified for traces to our collector; sample rate at 0.5% as requested.

Known issues and mitigations:
- Edge worker cold-latency during the first priming run (330ms) — mitigation: staggered priming script included in smoke-runbook.md; consider a short traffic ramp after cut for 10 minutes.

Acceptance artifact:
- Attached: firewall-acceptance-rules.txt (final ruleset stub) and ops-bridge-log-20250530.tar.gz (logs). I'll assemble the signed acceptance PDF and circulate.

Next steps:
- Monica: please confirm Acme will apply the ruleset exactly as attached and confirm the doc signature path (DocuSign link preferred).
- Connor: please coordinate rollback criteria and keep the rollback playbook on-standby during cut.

Karthik Iyer
Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: firewall-acceptance-rules.txt (TXT, 6KB); ops-bridge-log-20250530.tar.gz (TAR.GZ, 2.1MB)]

From: Jordan Ellis <acme-ops@acmecloud.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: RE: Go-live gating — quick confirmation and bridge walk request

Thanks everyone — appreciate the thorough run. Acme Ops will apply the attached ruleset verbatim at cut time and initiate the traffic flip at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. We'll use the Drive folder to store the signed acceptance PDF and finalize via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Acme-RI-SLA-2025.

A couple of quick asks before we flip: 
- Please include the staggered priming step in the final acceptance PDF (we'll ramp traffic for 10m post-cut).
- Connor, please confirm the rollback playbook location (link or commit id).

We'll ping on the bridge if anything unexpected shows up during the first 15 minutes. Otherwise, we consider this green and will mark the cut as accepted.

Jordan Ellis
Principal Cloud Engineer, Acme Cloud
acme-ops@acmecloud.com
[Attachment: acme-acknowledge-20250530.txt (TXT, 1KB)]
